2026 Election Guide & Verification Standard

Official guidelines, security architecture, voting procedures, and verifier tool.

Official 5-Step Voting Workflow

Follow these quick, standardized steps to ensure your vote is cast cleanly and securely.

Step 1

Voter Authentication & Identity Check

Log in using your registered National Identification Number (NIN) or Voter Identification Number (VIN) along with your secure account passcode.

Tip: Ensure your credentials match your INEC voter registration card details.
Step 2

Token Generation & Ballot Access

Upon identity verification, the system issues a single-use Authorization Token. This token unlocks your official digital ballot corresponding to your designated state and constituency.

Step 3

Candidate Selection & Ballot Marking

Review candidates across available executive and legislative offices (e.g. Presidential, Gubernatorial, Senate). Select your preferred candidate or tap "Abstain" for any position.

Step 4

Pre-Submission Review & Cryptographic Seal

Carefully verify your selections on the Review page. Once satisfied, click "Cryptographically Seal & Submit Ballot".

Notice: After final confirmation, choices cannot be changed.
Step 5

Receipt Download & Immutable Log Record

Your ballot is recorded onto the SHA-256 block ledger. Download or save your official Digital Voting Receipt containing your audit hash for personal verification.

Ready to Participate?

Voting polls close at 18:00 WAT. Make sure your vote is registered on time.
